verdict.rationale: Datalab documents its own conversion of images and scanned PDFs into machine-readable text, and mentions processing scans for redline extraction, so the core OCR capability for scanned and photographed documents exists. Nothing in the pack shows accuracy on skewed pages, stamps or low-quality scans, and no hands-on report covers scanned input. Missing for 10: documented handling of skewed or rotated pages, stamp and seal robustness, low-quality or photographed scan accuracy, independent benchmarks or hands-on corroboration on scanned documents.

support.subject: As a developer, scanned and photographed documents OCR accurately — skewed pages, stamps, low quality scans included

citations.quote: Convert a PDF, image, or document to markdown, HTML, JSON, or chunks.
Extract redlines and comments from Word documents, PDFs, and scans
Datalab provides document intelligence APIs to convert PDFs, spreadsheets, and images into structured, machine-readable outputs.
Converts PDF, image, PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, HTML, EPUB files in all languages
